context_for_next_testing_agent: Sports classification LAYER 3.5 fix verified. The bug was that Polymarket API returns category='other' for many sports markets, but polymarket_api.py correctly sets asset_class='sports'. The fix adds LAYER 3.5 in TagLibraryService.classify_market() to check asset_class field when API category is 'other'. All 29 tests pass covering: LAYER 3.5 asset_class fallback for sports/crypto/politics/geopolitics/entertainment/science-tech/economics, HFT engine filtering, MarketDataService and RealTimeMarketService category classification, edge cases (empty/other/default/finance asset_class), and priority order verification.

bug_rca.root_cause: Polymarket API returns category='other' for many sports markets. The previous fix addressed polymarket_scanner.py but MarketDataService, RealTimeMarketService, and TagLibraryService had additional code paths that weren't using the asset_class field set by polymarket_api.py
bug_rca.impact: Sports markets like 'Pelicans vs. Jazz' with category='other' but asset_class='sports' were being classified as 'default' and routed to HFT lane instead of SPORTS lane
bug_rca.fix_applied: Added LAYER 3.5 in TagLibraryService.classify_market() (lines 822-848) to check asset_class field when API category is 'other'. Also updated MarketDataService and RealTimeMarketService to reclassify markets with category='other'
bug_rca.verification: 29 pytest tests verify the fix works for all scenarios: asset_class fallback for all categories, HFT filtering, service-level classification, edge cases, and priority order
